dedupe_keys.name: north carolina division of waste management site locator tool

description: The Site Locator Tool is a web map that brings together every site permitted or overseen by North Carolina's Division of Waste Management, including solid waste facilities such as landfills, transfer stations and compost sites, hazardous waste sites, Superfund and brownfield sites, and underground storage tanks. It is published by the North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality, which combined several of its databases and GIS layers into one application. Users can search by address, name or identifier, view the records for a site, see neighbouring regulated sites, query and download results, print maps, and open linked documents in the division's Laserfiche file room; environmental monitoring data are kept separately in the EQuIS system. Coverage is statewide at site level. Use is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: underground storage tank files are still being converted from paper, document links depend on the file room, and bulk export is limited to what the map's query tools allow. Simulation uses: locations and status of waste facilities and contaminated sites for waste network, disaster debris and flood exposure models in North Carolina. Related records: the Arkansas permitted solid waste facility data (data-arkansas-deq-permitted-solid-waste-facilities) and the Texas active facility data (data-tceq-msw-facility-data-files) are state equivalents.
